_why: One versioned statement of what each box offers the pool, so a supervisor on any box can be started by an identical command line and the shape of the fleet is a file somebody can read rather than three hand-typed invocations nobody wrote down. Values here are the ones the loops were observed running on 2026-09-03; changing the fleet means changing this file. Raised 2026-09-04 against measurement, not intuition: see _measured_2026_09_04.

gx10-6b77._alias_why: The OS hostname is now sparklina. The supervisor resolves this explicit alias to the same shape; both names remain placement tags for existing submissions.

_measured_2026_09_04: Both GB10 boxes are 121 GB unified. The historical gpu-slots values of two and three were concurrency guesses rather than hardware: each box has one physical GPU. They are retained here only as the measurement that exposed why fixed slots strand light jobs and stack heavy jobs; adaptive admission now consumes attributed broker telemetry instead. The RAM bounds remain 72 GiB on sparky and 80 GiB on sparklina because host-memory containment is a separate hard limit.
_capacity_policy_2026_09_05: Both GB10 boxes use the same --gpu policy. A trusted fresh broker snapshot detects physical devices and reports one on each current host; missing, stale, incomplete or unattributed evidence offers zero. The snapshot distinguishes shared-system memory from discrete VRAM, while mem-gb values remain host-RAM budgets. All hosts retain full inherited CPU capacity, with physical performance cores preferred and fallback CPUs allocated last.
_dl380_memory_2026_09_05: Raised the stale 60 GiB fleet ceiling to 192 GiB after measuring 294.5 GiB physical RAM, 230.6 GiB available, zero memory PSI and 48 GiB of active PB reservations using about 5 GiB. The 192 GiB aggregate budget leaves over 100 GiB outside PB's maximum reservation, including unrelated services and host margin. Live host observation can lower the offer; each action still reserves and enforces its full declared memory. See docs/dl380_memory_capacity_2026-09-05.md and issue #191.
_dl380_memory_2026_09_11: Reduced the aggregate PB memory budget from 192 to 96 GiB to preserve the storage server's ZFS ARC (issue #488). The host exposes 294.523 GiB physical RAM; its runtime zfs_arc_min is 176 GiB and zfs_arc_sys_free is 16 GiB, leaving 102.523 GiB before other services. The 96 GiB declaration leaves 6.523 GiB beyond those floors. Fresh host observation can lower admission further; full per-action reservation and containment remain required. The legacy 3600-second ceiling is unchanged: progress-v1 actions use it as a per-phase stall bound and retain any explicit sealed deadline.
_gb10_memory_2026_09_07: Raised both GB10 aggregate memory budgets to 96 GiB for a full calibration capture, selected by the root reviewer from measured headroom after Rob authorized increasing memory limits; decision recorded in issue #322. Linux exposes 121.627 GiB physical memory. Initial live samples had over 110 GiB available with zero memory PSI; a later sparky sample fell to 95.872 GiB, so headroom is a fresh admission condition, not a permanent grant. A 96 GiB action must wait for existing reservations to drain; no 104/112 GiB overlap budget is added. Preserve the 8 GiB host-availability margin, complete reservations and the GPU subset cap. See docs/gb10_memory_capacity_2026-09-07.md.
_gb10_memory_104_2026_09_07: Revised the earlier 96 GiB decision to 104 GiB for an isolated whole-GPU calibration measurement after source-derived finalization sizing found a 93.756 GiB tensor floor before runtime overhead (issue #326). Rob authorized raising limits; root selected this revised budget. Idle sparklina had 115.638 GiB available at 04:59:15Z, zero memory PSI, and complete attributed broker evidence with no jobs or foreign GPU processes. Sparky was busy below the required 112 GiB fresh headroom. A 104 GiB action waits for other reservations to drain; this increase does not authorize overlap. Preserve the 8 GiB host margin and GPU subset cap. Physical memory outside the aggregate ceiling is 17.627 GiB. See docs/gb10_memory_104_capacity_2026-09-07.md.
